hook: Say what you think without claiming more than you know.
intro: Hedging changes how a German reader takes you more than almost anything else. Say etwas ist so and you have claimed it; say etwas dürfte so sein and you have said the same thing while showing you know the difference between what you can prove and what you suspect. Write 900 to 1800 characters. The correction looks at whether each claim carries the right strength, whether what you heard somewhere is marked as such, and whether a disagreement stays a disagreement rather than becoming an attack.
tips[0].title: Three strengths of guess
tips[0].text: dürfte is a confident estimate, könnte an open possibility, müsste a conclusion you are fairly sure of. They are the subjective modals, and they all point at your confidence rather than at an obligation or an ability.
tips[0].check.why: dürfte is a confident estimate; könnte and mag leave it open.
tips[0].trap: Hedging everything is its own mistake: a text with no firm sentence in it reads as having nothing to say.
tips[1].title: sollen and wollen carry hearsay
tips[1].text: sollen reports what others say about someone; wollen reports what someone claims about themselves. Both let you pass a claim on without adopting it, which is exactly what a forum post needs.
tips[1].check.why: wollen reports his own claim about himself.
tips[2].title: Disagree with the point, not the person
tips[2].text: A softened opening lets you contradict hard. Da wäre ich vorsichtig, Ich würde eher sagen, Das sehe ich anders. The disagreement itself can then be direct, and nobody reads it as an attack.
tips[2].check.why: The Konjunktiv II softens the frame; the claim underneath stays firm.
remember[0]: dürfte confident, könnte open, müsste concluded.
remember[1]: sollen for what others say, wollen for what someone claims of themselves.
remember[2]: Mark your own experience as experience: meiner Erfahrung nach.
remember[3]: Soften the frame, not the point.
exam: Writing a reasoned post into an existing discussion is a C1 writing task, and the register most people actually write German in.
mistakes[0].why: A claim you cannot prove needs its hedge.
mistakes[1].why: sollen passes the claim on without adopting it.
mistakes[2].why: Without the perfect infinitive this is a demand, not a rumour.
mistakes[3].why: Same disagreement, a register that gets read.
